text:
alex: Quick sync — we need to choose the observability cut for the upcoming console beta. Two paths: (A) dashboards-first (cost + error slices, per-route breakdowns, dashboard templates) or (B) tracing-first (span hooks, distributed traces, error context). Need product priority + minimum launch criteria by EOD.

morgan: Can you add the customer asks? My enterprise reps keep asking for per-route cost & error-runbooks. Dashboards hit that faster.

sam: FYI APAC pilot customers require detailed traces for incident audits. Tracing matters for compliance, but I get dashboards are faster. Tradeoffs: tracing = storage + perf overhead.

rita: Leaning hybrid: ship dashboard MVP with a very small sampling of traces and lightweight span markers for error paths. Acceptance: show per-route cost, error-rate delta, and ability to fetch a sampled trace for any error spike. Canary plan + rollback. :white_check_mark:

ben: Quick sampling config prototype (very rough):
```
tracing:
  sampling: 0.01 # 1% global
  error_sampling: 1.0 # 100% when error occurs
  span_marker: "redwood.span.error"
```
At 1% we should be within budget for 100M tokens/day load, but need bench numbers. :bar_chart:

lisa: UI note — dashboards-first means we can ship table-driven templates for SREs + product teams. Tracing requires a comfy trace viewer which is more UI work. Templates give immediate value.

alex: Summary proposal for decision: dashboards-first MVP with:
- per-route cost breakdown (top 20 routes)
- error analytics + slice view (by model, route, customer)
- trace-lite: 1% global + 100% on errors, span markers for hot paths
Launch criteria: latency impact <5% p50/p95, cost delta <=10% for infra, able to show per-route cost and at least one sampled trace for any error slice.

morgan: I approve prioritizing per-route cost + error slices for v1. Tracing-lite as follow-up but make sure hooks exist in runtime to toggle sampling quickly. :thumbsup:

sam: Agree with tracing-lite (error-only hooks). We should avoid full distributed traces on by default — too risky for latency and storage.

rita: I can prototype the sampling toggle + dashboard queries next sprint. Who can spare an infra engineer for the bench/rollout? Asking for 2 sprints to get a canary in prod.

deploy-bot: Issue created: https://tracker/redwood/PRD-589 "obs: dashboards-first beta plan + trace-lite prototype" — assignees: rita, ben, sam.

alex: Thanks — I'll add this decision to the roadmap doc and surface the launch criteria in the sprint planning ticket. If anyone has objections, speak now, otherwise I'll lock the plan at EOD. :lock:
